batting.name: JEC Franklin
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b M Muralitharan

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c M Muralitharan b HV Patel

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b M Muralitharan

balls.text: bowls it across Pollard, he fetches that from outside off and swings it to Agarwal on the first bounce at deep midwicket
comes round the wicket and it;s a low full toss and it's swung down to deep midwicket, Agarwal dives and does well to palm it away
he errs by bowling a length ball this time, no real change of pace and he goes deep at the crease and pulls flat over deep square leg
the first massive Pollard hit, Vinay banged it in short and he made a lot of room and clubbed it over long leg
slower ball and a bit short, he pulls hard but finds deep square leg
down the leg side and he pulls fine but Zaheer picks it up
ends the over with a sharp yorker which he manages to dig out
lucky boundary here, tries to launch it over the on side but gets a top edge that clears short third man
slower ball and he swings too early and the ball clips is body and rolls away

one of the more audacious shots seen today, it was a low full toss angling towards leg and all it took was a wristy flick to send it flat down to deep square leg, the umpires thought it was a six but it was just short
makes room and thuds and full delivery down to long-on
comes round the wicket and bowls the slower ball, he swings and misses
tossed up quicker and defended with soft hands, good end to the over
defends it towards cover
goes for the heave but gets an inside edge to the leg side
breaks the shackles, flighted on the off stump and he gets forward and lofts cleanly, one bounce to long-on
goes back and whips it away down to deep square leg
floated on the pads and worked down to long-on
tucked him up again, he gets an outside edge to point
bowls it short from round the wicket and he fends it off his body to fine leg
tucks him up for room and he gets an outside edge down to third man
drifted on the pads and he clips him down to fine leg
gets across and tamely drives it back to the bowler
comes round the wicket and beats the outside edge, he was only half forward
stays back and whips it with the turn to midwicket
he's on a hat-trick here! Smith fails to read the doosra, he tries to loft straight and gets a tame top edge that goes to point
holed out to the deep! Karthik gets well forward and tries to slog it over long-on but it was well short of the rope, Kohli falls forward and takes it
gets on his knee to sweep but gets a top edge that lands wide of short fine leg
comes down the track and chips it wide of long-on but it's picked up
stays back and clips it to the on side
full and wide and bashed straight to cover
stays back and punches it to long-on
goes back and punches it to the on side
good improvisation again, dropped short down the leg side and he swivels and pulls behind square
poor delivery, dropped it too short and he went across and pulled it over midwicket
beaten on the drive and the ball hits his back leg after chipping down the track
the slower ball gets him, Rayudu tries to clear long-off, half-hearted shot, didn't read the pace of the ball and it was taken by Murali well in front of the rope
looked like it landed on the rope! In fact it bounced just an inch in front of it, down the track and he whips it in the air to deep midwicket, the umpire confirms that it's a four
short delivery and he pulls him to midwicket
gets across and works it wide of cover
comes down the track and bashes a length ball over the covers, he followed the movement, lovely shot
tucked him up for room and he adjusted well by dabbing it wide of point
a long time coming, Karthik chucks the sweep option and decides to come down the track and loft his Tamil Nadu team-mate over deep midwicket, clean hit
down the track and forced to deep midwicket
comes down the track and pushes it to long-off
sweeps but again he mistimes it
comes down the track and punches it down to long-on
stays back and whips it down to wide long-on for a couple
goes back and chops it towards point for a single
comes down the track and chips it with the turn in the air and it drops short of deep midwicket
this one fizzes past the edge as he tries to run it down to third man
chips down the track and lofts and it lands on the vacant mid-on region
shorter one and he swivels and pulls to short fine leg
tucked away down to midwicket and the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and Kohli fails to back up properly
down the track and punched to the off side
tries to loft it over cover but it flies off the edge and just clears point, Mayank Agarwal gives the chase and tries to pull it back but the ball hits the rope
down the track and punches him down to short cover
gets on his knee and sweeps  but doesn't get the timing, down to deep square leg
gets across and clips him down to the leg side
comes forward and forces it down to deep midwicket
tries to cut but gets an inside edge that bounces and hits the keeper's pads
tossed up on the off stump and driven down to long-off
fullish on the pads and worked down to long-on
fullish on the pads and he clips it to the leg side
tried the reverse sweep and he missed it, down the leg side
gets forward and punches it down the track
a touch shorter outside off and punched away down to the sweeper on the off side
gets across and punches it to the off side
the rookie gets the Big Fish! Patel banged it in shorter and Tendulkar tried to club that to the on side but got a top edge that swirled and was safely taken by the bowler
he whacks this one alright, this was a bit wide outside off, he stepped down the track and punched it on the up wide of cover
swings it in and he clears the front leg and tries to wham it through the on side but mistimes it to mid-on
down the track and punched in the air down to sweeper cover
fires it down the leg side, Tendulkar sweeps but misses
bowls it a touch shorter and he pulls off the front foot to deep square leg
comes down the track and the bowler follows him and fires it on the pads, worked to the leg side
he gives him the charge and chips it hard and in the air down to long-on
bowls it on the pads and he whips it well wide of short fine leg, deep  square leg mops up
floats it to the off stump and he clips it to the on side
on the pads and he whips it down to midwicket
bowls it shorter and he stays back and punches it to the off side
angles it across him and he punches it to sweeper cover again
comes down the track and drives on the up down to sweeper cover
leading edge! That hurried on to Tendulkar and Dilshan leapt at point to hang on to it, that was too quick for the fielder
angles across and he opens the face and dabs it down to third man
bowls it straight and tucks him up, defended softly, 13 off the over
make that three in three, Vinay bowls it full and really wide, he couldn't resist chasing that and scooped it wide of point, third man too had no chance
back to back boundaries, Vinay bowls a half volley on middle and leg and he dispatches it off the front foot well wide of mid-on
took a while coming, he gives him width and lands it on a good length, Tendulkar punches it off the front foot and beats mid-off and cover
fires that full and Tendulkar gets behind it and drives but can't get it past the bowler
comes down the track and mistimes the punch, it drops well short of mid-off
sits up and he nicely punches it off the back foot but can't beat cover
this time Tendulkar opens the face and just about squeezes it past point
brilliant stuff from Kohli! Karthik was down the track and he bashed that to the covers and Kohli saved a certain boundary, flung himself to his left
tries to steer it wide of point but Dilshan dives and saves it
seams away from him and beats the edge, good delivery
Mumbai will take more of these, drifts on the pads and he easily runs it down to fine leg, beats the keeper
Karthik took a few paces down and he fended it off high on the bat, quick single
he opens the face of the bat and angles it to third man, should be relieved to be at the other end
a direct hit would have sent him back! Pushed towards point and he wanted the run, darted back and Kohli's throw was just wide, Tendulkar had given up
big inside edge onto the pads and Vinay thought he had him, Tendulkar is struggling here, he just about made it back to beat the throw by Dilshan
bowls it straight and he defends back to the bowler
hits him on the pads as he tries to clip it to the on side and that was very close, Vinay appealed but the umpire wasn't so sure, looked like hitting leg
lands it wide outside off and Karthik leaves it alone, ball came back in slightly
drifts on the pads and he finally gets off the mark with a flick to fine leg
good carry again! Good Test match pitch this, Tendulkar safely leaves it alone
good length angling across and left alone
vintage Zaheer here, another one angles across Tendulkar and he still has no answers, very close to the edge again
angles it really wide across the right-hander and he chases that and nearly edges it
keeps it straight again and he defends solidly
that's a double-strike by Vinay! Rohit playing across the line, the ball landed just a shade outside off and was angling in slightly, tried to whip that to the leg side, plumb in front
he gets across and softly pushes it to the off side
keeps it straight and he gets across and knocks it back to the bowler
drifts down the leg side and wide called, tried to run that down

Zak's taken it! Vinay banged this one in short and angled it across the left-hander, Franklin tried to cut that over third man using the pace of the ball but it dipped and was comfortably taken by Zaheer running to his right
nicely pushed back to the bowler, Franklin's still a bit cautious here
gets behind the line and defends to the bowler
the Zaheer special! But no wicket, this one seamed away and had Tendulkar following it, nearly took the edge
walks right across his stumps and works it down to fine leg, Mumbai off the mark
half hearted cut and Franklin is completely beaten, didn't move his feet
goes for the drive but gets a thick inside edge to his pads
good seam movement inwards and good carry as well to the keeper
straight six to wrap things up! Kohli gives the charge and sends it whistling over the sight screen and over the second tier, classic shot
punched to the covers
bowls it full and he works it to the on side
it was a flat delivery but still good enough for Gayle, makes room and shovels it over wide long-on and it's the 500th six of the tournament, nearly dented the Volkswagen!
flatter delivery and worked to square leg
stays back and thumps it to long-on
stays at the crease and stabs it down to mid-off
short and pulled and deep midwicket picks it up
angles it on the pads and easily done to long-on
fullish on the stumps and worked down to long-on
fires it on the pads and squirted to fine leg
full on the stumps and squeezed out to long-off
fired in full outside off and he hammers it across the line to long-on
squirts out a yorker and he scampers a quick single, Malinga runs across to pick up and throw
banged in short and he pulled it along the ground to deep square leg
yorker length outside off and squeezed out to the off side
bowls it full and quick and he wristily flicks it wide of square leg
bowls a wide down the leg side, tries to hammer it to the leg side
take cover! Tossed up outside off and Gayle bends his knee and scoops it high and down to the second tier over the sightscreen, You can't snooze away when he's batting
stays at the crease and tries to slam it over the on side but ends up scooping it over the bowler
full on the pads and pushed down the ground
comes across his stumps and gets an outside edge to point, scampers the single
full delivery and he comes down the track and hammers it along the ground wide of long-on, beats the two fielders in the deep
on the pads and pushed down to long-on
punched down to point
plonks forward and pushed down to point
appeal for a caught behind and Gayle survives! Tossed up from round the wicket and it turned away, Gayle poked at it and it looked like it just beat the edge
stays back and pulls him down to long-on
goes back and clips it to the on side
full and wide and softly pushed down to long-off
goes back and punches it on the up down to third man
short down the leg side again and he swivels and pulls over fine leg, didn't look in control but good enough
bowls the bouncer down the leg side and it's one for the over
full on the pads and driven just wide of the bowler
bashed away! It was a friendly length ball and Gayle stood at the crease, waited patiently and clubbed it with force down to deep midwicket
nicely driven but well stopped by Harbhajan at short extra cover
tucked to the leg side and he's sent back, there's a direct hit and Gayle just about makes his ground, the third umpire takes a look
down the track and the ball clips his pads
stays back and punches it down to long-off
goes back and punches it to the off side
on his knee and sweeps hard down to deep square leg
no respite off the extra ball! Ojha tossed it up outside off and Gayle got forward and scooped it down to the second tier over long-off
here we go again! Another full toss, identical to the last one and this time he clubbed it over deep square leg, what's more it's a no-ball for height!
a full toss to Gayle and what else would you expect? He came forward and whacked that effortlessly over deep midwicket
tossed up and he clips it down to deep square leg
comes forward and clips it hard down to mid-on
jams out a full delivery back to the bowler
goes back and clips it to the leg side
stays back and punches it back to the bowler
cuts it to deep point
pushed to cover
comes forward and drives to long-off

Dilshan's not happy! Dilshan was on his knee to paddle it away and the ball clearly lobbed off the pad to the keeper, Bowden took his time and gave it out but replays showed the ball did not hit his pad or bat, a frustrated Dilshan threw his gloves after crossing the boundary
Chance! Gayle swings a low full toss and it travels flat and quick and drops just short of the substitute fielder at deep square leg
bowls it flat and on the pads and he squeezes it to the on side
tossed up on the pads and another sweep finds short fine leg
gets forward and clips it to the on side
cleverly played! It was flat and he used the pace to steer it down to third man, beats the fielder in the circle
swept but Tendulkar's there at short fine leg to cut it off
on the pads and Gayle sweeps but finds deep square leg
comes round the wicket and he stays back and clips it to the on side

he decapitated Dilshan there! He seems ok now, Gayle really thudded that off the back foot but Dilshan came in the way, the ball deflected to Pollard who tried to run Dilshan out, he made it back to the crease
stays back and punches it hard past Harbhajan at short cover
drifts on the body and works it to square leg
stays back and defends with soft hands, Pollard's taking a lot of pace off the ball
stays back and cuts and the fielder at point lets it through his legs, no this is not the Deccan Chargers
bowls a full delivery on the pads and Gayle is happy to softly push it to the off side
comes down the track and tries to loft over the off side but misses
comes forward and pushes it to cover
shapes to drive but misses
Smith drops a swirler! How much will that cost? Gayle moved away and got a top edge that swirled an eternity and Smith got under it but failed to hang on, he was stationed in the off side
brute force! It was a short ball which sat up nicely for Gayle to club that from outside off and clear deep midwicket
punched off the front foot just wide of mid-off but Franklin slides and cuts it off
length ball on leg stump, Gayle defends it back towards the bowler to end the over
a low full toss on off and middle, little footwork from Gayle as he nudges that towards midwicket
slower offcutter outside off, 132 kph, Gayle shows his softer side, just opens the face and guides it past short third man for four
slips in the bouncer, 143.1kph, on legstump, Gayle was looking to play it to the leg side, then at the last moment he ducks under it
a low full toss just outside off, punched towards cover
outside off and that is chopped towards point by Dilshan
pitched up this time by RP, punched towards extra cover for a single to end the over
closer to off, short of length once more, careful defence to the off side
this time it is Dilshan who cuts for four, it was back of a length from RP, not too wide of off either, wide enough for Dilshan to slash it behind backward point, Dilshan is terrific on the cut
length ball just outside off, pushed for a single towards cover off the back foot
again room for Gayle, it's fuller than the last time, Gayle scythes that past point for four more, Ambati Rayudu dives at point but that was too powerfully hit
RP Singh gives some width, short as well, and that is slammed over cover by Gayle, a couple of bounces for four
cramps him up for room and he just pushes it down the track
tucks him up for room but he opens the face and steers it wide of point
quick delivery, short and straight and had Gayle defending that, he's not hitting those yet
full and wide and another slower ball, Gayle is still nailed to the crease, steers it to point and Dilshan had to dive to make his ground
the slower ball! Gayle looked a bit at sea there, he was rooted to the crease and poked his bat out
fires in the yorker and Gayle can only jam it down the track
stabbed down to cover and he sets off for a quick single, lucky it wasn't a direct hit or Gayle would have gone
tests him out with the bouncer and he's happy to duck under that one
this one nipped back in off the sea, he tried to work it to the leg side but the ball skidded through
comes down the track and the he mistimes it to the leg side
lands it on a length outside off and he safely lets it go
142.9 kph, another quick one! Really kicked up on a length outside off, he wisely didn't offer a shot
edged and beats the slips! He poked at it but luckily with soft hands, bounced in front of Harbhajan at first slip and beat him and ran to third man
doesn't give him much room and he punches it hard down to cover
bangs it on a good length and he chops it hard down to cover point
flashes at that, 142 kph, really fizzede through and beat the outside edge
low full toss outside off and angling across him, attempted yorker, steered down to backward point
